name: Heart of Disruption
summary: Magus Wordeen Voidglare lets you past his wards into Dalaran to seek an Arcane Mote. He fears the city’s fall could bring catastrophe to the Undercity as well.

sections.title: A Key Through the Wards
sections.body: Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill sends you into Dalaran with a key he has imbued to pass his wards. He fears that if the city falls, the Undercity will be threatened too. Find the Arcane Mote and meet him at the Violet Citadel, where this began; preventing catastrophe comes first.

faq.answer: Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill sends you into Dalaran to find an Arcane Mote.

faq.q: Why am I going to Dalaran?
faq.answer: You are sent to find an Arcane Mote. Wordeen fears Dalaran’s fall could bring the Undercity down with it.

faq.q: How do I get past Wordeen's wards?
faq.answer: Wordeen imbues your key so it can pass his wards and let you enter the city.
Wordeen asks you to meet him at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran, where this began.
Wordeen says preventing a catastrophe comes first.

attribution: In-game quest text: Heart of Disruption
